cards.name: Full Steam Ahead
cards.oracleText: Until end of turn, each creature you control gets +2/+2 and gains trample and "This creature can't be blocked by more than one creature."

cards.name: Full Flowering
cards.oracleText: Populate X times. (To populate, create a token that's a copy of a creature token you control. Do this X times.)

cards.name: Fully Grown
cards.oracleText: Target creature gets +3/+3 until end of turn. Put a trample counter on it.

cards.name: Full Moon's Rise
cards.oracleText:
Werewolf creatures you control get +1/+0 and have trample.
Sacrifice this enchantment: Regenerate all Werewolf creatures you control.

cards.name: Plant a Sapling // Fully-Grown Treefolk
cards.oracleText:
Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle this spell into its owner's library transformed. (For playtesting purposes, put it into its sleeve upside down.)
(You can't cast this face unless it's been transformed by the front face.)
Fully-Grown Treefolk's power and toughness are each equal to the number of lands you control.

cards.name: Full Throttle
cards.oracleText:
After this main phase, there are two additional combat phases.
At the beginning of each combat this turn, untap all creatures that attacked this turn.

cards.name: Full Bore
cards.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +3/+2 until end of turn. If that creature was cast for its warp cost, it also gains trample and haste until end of turn.
